newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Podravka rises to 390 kn, boosts market.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Podravka rises to 390 kn, boosts market.

text.p: Croatian food firm Podravka hit 390 kuna by 1230 local (1130 GMT) on Wednesday from 375 kuna on strong buying that boosted the sluggish stock market, traders said.
"Podravka is going strong," one trader with a large market share told Reuters.
"The price crept up in a few transactions this morning and then varied. But it seems to be stabilising at a higher level."
Hotelier Laguna also rose to 1,400 kuna from 1,353 at Tuesday's close, the trader said.
Blue chip pharmaceutical stock Pliva traded in a 510-510 kuna range but volume was low.
Zagrebacka Banka fetched 1,900 kuna in one deal, but was bid around 1,860 just over one hour before the end of session.

Podravka has been the most active since the beginning of the year. It has gained over 60 percent amid what analysts attribute to a stronger interest by foreigners, seeking to diversify their portfolio.
So far, foreign investors have mostly been buying fully-listed Pliva and Zagrebacka whose global depositary receipts (GDRs) are also traded in London.
